name: ok-asks-whether-the-step-before-stood
query: get [(5 | ok !| false) (!{:k 1} | raise | ok !| false)]

name: error-test-in-a-template
query: get [(!{:kind :oops} | raise | ok !| false) (42 | ok !| false)]

name: a-catch-whose-label-takes-errors-holds-the-error-at-rest-under-it
query: :Late |~~ Late. ~~| (::kind | accepts |~~ The facts. ~~| #[::map ::error]); ::Late{:by 3} | raise !| get [tag /by]

name: a-raised-map-is-caught-under-the-kind-of-errors-once
query: get [(!{:a 1} | raise !| payload | tag) ({:a 1} | raise !| payload | tag)]

name: a-caught-error-of-a-refusal-answers-its-facts-by-their-names
query: 1 | add "x" !| get [(addend | expected) (addend | found | tag) (addend | found) (trace | count)]

name: settle-holds-the-failure-of-a-question-as-its-error-at-rest
query: {:age null} | settle [(get /age | add 1)] | get /0/error | get [tag (subject | found)]

name: a-catch-whose-scope-declares-the-label-of-the-error-otherwise-answers-the-refusal-of-that-label
query: :P |~~ P ~~| (::kind | accepts |~~ m ~~| ::map); (:P |~~ P ~~| (::kind | accepts |~~ x ~~| #[::map ::error]); ::P{:a 1} | raise) !| it !| get [tag (trace | first | failed)]
